trackerLog.subject: Asteria
trackerLog.focus: Pitch, cast, storyboard draft, feature list

feature.title: Party of eight playable characters
feature.notes: Cael Ward, Liraen Quill, Brann Dur, Seris Vale, Rook Fenn, Ysolde Rhea, Ash Korv, Nym Hale. FF8 proportions and fashion. Active battle party of three. Full eight unlocked by Act 5.

feature.title: Three main villains
feature.notes: Forge-King Vortan (Constium / World Cannon). Archon Velith (Bengenia / Mist). Nyxara the Hollow Flame (Temple of Fire / Maze Fissure). Face order: Velith, Vortan, Nyxara.

feature.title: Six Temples as world pillars
feature.notes: Mist, Earth, Water, Fire, Life, Light. Each grants a Temple Sigil used in combat and story gates. FF9 crystal analog. Not collectible macguffins only; each temple is a dungeon plus a civic religion.

feature.title: World Cannon as industrial superweapon
feature.notes: FF7 Midgar-reactor energy. Built by Constium to kill Nyxara. Firing it would unseal her. Mid-game reveal; endgame dungeon is the Cannon barrel plus Maze Fissure under it.

feature.title: Overworld follows the master map of Asteria
feature.notes: Four polities: Breskshire (Human Empire), Constium (Dwarven Empire), Iunum (Elven Empire), Bengenia (Pale Kingdom). King's Sea center. Orc Invasion NE. Towns on the attached map are real stops. Scale bar is canon distance.

feature.title: Combat: ATB, Trance, Temple Sigils
feature.notes: FF9 ATB plus short Trance. Sigils are FF8 junction-lite: attach a temple aspect to a weapon or armor, not to raw stats. Active three, swap from eight. No random-every-step; encounter gauge plus visible field hunters.

feature.title: World vehicles including late airship
feature.notes: Foot, ferry on King's Sea, dwarf-rail through Constium, airship from Queen's Cove after Act 4. Airship does not skip temple story gates.

feature.title: Sidelines: song-duel and brass cards
feature.notes: Valley of Songs theater/song minigame (FF9 Tantalus energy). Brass Lands card game (FF8 Triple Triad energy). Optional, pays unique gear.

feature.title: Framefield board pack for the storyboard
feature.notes: When FrameField SET-1.0 exports, board Asteria as sequences Act 0 through Act 7. Do not start boarding until this design draft is accepted. This chat does not modify FrameField source.

set.title: Pitch and style bible
set.intent: Lock tone before systems or boarding.
set.exit: Style refs agreed: FF9 high-fantasy tone, FF8 character design, FF7 world contrast. Working title Asteria.
set.include: High fantasy, theatrical kingdoms, industrial vs temple nature
Character art: realistic FF8 proportions, ornate wearable clothes, guns only as rare machina
World art: regional biomes, visible industry at Constium and World Cannon, mist around Bengenia

set.title: Narrative storyboard draft
set.intent: A discussable act list tied to the master map.
set.exit: Eight acts from Padon prologue to Cannon/Fissure finale. Open for rewrite.
set.include: Act 1 Breskshire, Meddos, Timshaw, Iron's Gate
Act 2 Constium, Temple of Earth, World Cannon tour
Act 3 Bengenia, Temple of Mist, Velith unmasked
Act 4 Iunum, Valley of Songs, Queen's Cove, Temple of Water
Act 5 Orc Invasion, Brass Lands, Breakwoods, Temple of Fire
Act 6 Tierso, Temple of Life, Temple of Light
Act 7 World Cannon firing, Maze Fissure, Nyxara

set.title: Cast lock (8 + 3)
set.intent: Names and roles exist so later boards have labels.
set.exit: Eight mains and three villains named, origin on the map, join act listed.

set.title: World of Asteria from master map
set.intent: The attached map is canon layout.
set.exit: Polities, six temples, World Cannon, King's Sea, and Orc Invasion are placed.

set.title: Gameplay systems
set.intent: Combat and traversal after the story draft is accepted.
set.exit: ATB plus Trance plus Sigils written. Encounter rules written. Vehicles gated.

trackerLog.decision: New vault project Logs-Asteria. Subject string Asteria exact. This is design only; no game source and no FrameField source from this chat.
World name Asteria. Layout is the attached World Map - Master.
Style mix: FF9 high-fantasy tone and structure, FF8 character design, FF7 world contrast (industry vs land).
Eight mains, three villains. Active battle party of three, roster of eight.
Six Temples (Mist, Earth, Water, Fire, Life, Light) plus World Cannon are the spine. Cannon is not a temple.
Draft names and plot are first pass. User rewrite wins.
trackerLog.note: Single-player high-fantasy JRPG adventure. Working title Asteria. Board later in FrameField (FEAT-009).

West isle Bengenia / Temple of Mist. SW peninsula Breskshire. Center Padon, Meddos, Iron's Gate, King's Sea. North Constium, Maze Fissure, World Cannon, Temple of Fire. East Iunum, Queen's Cove, Valley of Songs, Temple of Water. NE Orc Invasion, Brass Lands, Breakwoods. South Tierso, Temple of Life, Temple of Light.
